# Groq Free Qwen3.8-27B: last distinct route screen

**Classification:** local model-routing choice, not a Google-backed requirement or an external implementation technique. **Decision:** one scientific-first, fixed public-input request is justified; a production default is not.

The [current default receipt](m11-default-route-2026-09-26.json) records that all four Railway production roles still name `openrouter/nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro:free`, while the fresh OpenRouter catalog contains neither that exact Pro route nor Mini. The existing free-policy catalog check therefore rejects the configured system default. OpenRouter still lists `qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free` at zero prompt/completion token prices, but the retained ModelRun-hosted Qwen request returned a shared-pool 429 with no served-model receipt; reusing that host is not a demonstrated recovery.

Groq's currently published [`qwen/qwen3.8-27b` model page](https://console.groq.com/docs/model/qwen/qwen3.8-27b), [Free-plan limits](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits), [structured-output guide](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs), [tool guide](https://console.groq.com/docs/tool-use/overview), and [streaming guide](https://console.groq.com/docs/text-chat) advertise a distinct route with JSON Object/Schema, tool use, streaming, reasoning controls, 131,042-token context, and 16,384-token output ceiling. Groq lists 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD, 8,000 TPM and 200,000 TPD on Free. Structured output cannot be combined with tool use or streaming in one call; the app uses those in separate calls. The model is **Preview**, with discontinuation risk; the large context/output numbers do not override Free token quotas. The model page also advertises paid Developer rates, so the account's Free $0 plan, active key, inference-only ZDR and exact model availability must be rechecked before any request. [Groq data controls](https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data) describe inference ZDR; browser readback from the preceding 20B attempt showed it enabled, but must be refreshed.

This is not another GPT-OSS 20B/120B trial: Qwen3.8 is a different checkpoint, and Groq is a different host from the rate-limited ModelRun route. To limit campaign cost and model-selection churn, use the same public four-claim scientific boundary and stop after **one physical call** on the first wrong completed verdict, wrong citation, 429, provider error, missing served-model/usage, or route change. Only a pass can authorize separate JSON/tool/stream/long/reasoning tests and a measured full-run quota assessment. Do not infer broad scientific quality or suitability from advertised benchmarks or one passing synthetic case. Do not promote a Preview model without completed current-route verification.
